ios.desc:
Perky Credits is the all-in-one credit card rewards tracker, benefits manager, and spending optimizer. Track and automate card credits, maximize points and miles, search airport lounges, monitor transfer bonuses, activate offers from banks such as Amex Chase Citi and Bank of America, optimize spending categories, and always know which card to use — free.

The average premium cardholder wastes $1,000s in unused benefits every year on forgotten airline credits, expired streaming perks, lapsed free night certificates. PerkyCredits makes sure you use every one.

CREDIT CARD CREDIT TRACKER
Track every credit across all your cards: Uber, DoorDash, hotel, wellness, travel and more. Credits auto-renew each period. Swipe to mark used. Mute credits you skip. Set realized values. Get reminders before credits expire. Setup Autopilot and you won’t even have to click! 

BEST CARD RECOMMENDATIONS 
QuickPay uses your location to instantly show which credit card earns the most at any store, restaurant, or gas station. Wire it to your Action Button and pay with the best card with one tap without opening the app.

AUTOPILOT AUTOMATIC CREDIT TRACKING 
Link accounts to automatically detect when credits are redeemed. Auto-backfills transaction history for a complete spending picture. No manual input needed.

CREDIT CARD OFFERS 
Chrome extension activates offers from American Express, Chase, Citibank, and Bank of America across all cards with one click. Add the same offer to multiple Amex cards at once. Browse and activate hundreds of card-linked offers instantly.

SPENDING CATEGORY OPTIMIZER 
Cards ranked by rewards rate for every category: dining, groceries, gas, travel, hotels, streaming, online shopping, drugstores and more. Smart Point Valuation or custom valuations by loyalty program or card. Custom cards, custom multipliers, custom categories. Supports multiples of the same card.

AIRPORT LOUNGE FINDER 
Search airport lounges worldwide. Filter by your cards: Centurion Lounge, Priority Pass, Delta Sky Club, Capital One Lounge, United Club, Admirals Club and more. See nearby lounges with location enabled. Join select waitlists from the app.

POINTS MILES AND CERTIFICATE TRACKER 
Track rewards: Chase Ultimate Rewards, Amex Membership Rewards, Capital One Miles, Citi ThankYou Points, Bilt, Delta SkyMiles, American Airlines, United MileagePlus, Southwest, Marriott Bonvoy, Hilton Honors, Hyatt, IHG and more. Free night certificates, companion passes, upgrade certs.
